name: gaspol-catalog
description: Orchestrates B2B sales catalog and offer-deck creation for operations buyers, not investors: read the user's own knowledge base first and interview only the gaps, then storyline, then master catalog once, per-prospect variant many times, and a two-layer blocking gate that reviews the text AND the rendered image, plus a visual phase that authors the render prompts and a finish phase that writes what was learned back, so each deal starts further along than the last. Inherits the adversarial review engine from gaspol-pitch and swaps the rubric.
